resources.string: Save sync
Keeps the game\'s Save folder and a folder that you pick the same. Use it with a sync app such as Syncthing.
How it works
Before Play and before the official launcher, the app copies changes from the folder into the game.
After the game and after the official launcher, the app copies changes from the game to the folder.
The app never copies while the game runs.
When a character changed in both places, the copy saved last stays. The other copy goes to a backup.
Copies set aside in a conflict are in Save/Backups.
When you delete a character in one place, the app deletes it in the other place too, after a backup.
When you turn Save sync off, both copies stay.
